# zenfra_webhook_endpoint (Resource)

Manages an outbound webhook endpoint: Zenfra sends signed HTTP POST requests to `url` for the subscribed run events. Requires an Admin token. The signing secret is returned only when the endpoint is created and is kept in state from then on; an imported endpoint has no secret in state. Rotating the secret is done in the dashboard or the API, not here. Zenfra disables an endpoint automatically after repeated delivery failures; while `enabled = true` (the default), the next `terraform apply` shows `enabled` changing from `false` to `true` and re-enables it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zenfra_webhook_endpoint" "on_call" {
  url         = "https://hooks.example.com/zenfra"
  description = "Failures and approvals to the on-call channel"
  event_types = ["run.failed", "run.awaiting_approval"]
}

# The signing secret is only available when Terraform creates the endpoint.
# Use it to verify the webhook-signature header on deliveries.
output "on_call_webhook_secret" {
  value     = zenfra_webhook_endpoint.on_call.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (Set of String) The event types delivered to the endpoint, at least one: `run.<status>` for a run status (for example `run.failed`, `run.finished`, `run.awaiting_approval`) and `run.policy_reevaluated`. The API refuses an unknown type.
- `url` (String) The HTTPS URL deliveries are sent to. It must resolve to a public address; the API refuses private, loopback and link-local addresses and a host that does not resolve.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the endpoint, at most 200 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. Defaults to `true`. An endpoint Zenfra disabled after repeated delivery failures reads back as `false`, so an apply with `enabled = true` re-enables it.

### Read-Only

- `disabled_reason` (String) Why the endpoint is disabled: `manual` or `auto_failures`. Null when enabled.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the webhook endpoint.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The signing secret (`whsec_...`) used to verify deliveries. Set only when Terraform creates the endpoint; null after an import. A rotation in the dashboard or API is not reflected here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An imported endpoint has no secret in state: rotate it in the dashboard or API to obtain one.
terraform import zenfra_webhook_endpoint.on_call $WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_ID
```
